description: Diagnose CI cache misses: extract the hashed key inputs from the cache key template, classify each non-hit run by cause, and report hit rate, changed hashed files, and the most common cause.

key_template.description: Cache key as written in the workflow, e.g. with hashFiles('...') segments

restore_keys.description: Restore-key prefixes configured in the workflow (optional; echoed in the report)

runs.description: Cache outcomes to analyse (at least one)

outcome.description: Cache outcome: hit, partial, or miss

name: analyze_cache_miss
